notes.title: V1.1.0 brings many new features and improved gameplay
notes.content:
Hey everyone,
It's been an eventful first week after launching the game. I'm delighted with the game's overall performance, but of course, I'm also aware of some of the feedback, specifically on Steam.
So I've worked extensively over the past few days to address some of the gameplay criticism.

So today, it's time for the first major patch, which brings many new features and introduces a partnership with Lovense.
If you connect your Lovense toy with the game, it will vibrate whenever your host takes part in sexual interactions. Of course, this only works in the NSFW modes of the game.

The main gameplay improvements on the Idle game front are more automatization through Bacteriophages (Auto-Buyers) and Stochastic Fluctuation (Auto-Levelers). You can unlock these through Mutation Boons and also get permanent ones at the end of a run.

Here's the full list of the changes.


V1.1.0 Changelog
[list]
[*] Lovense Toy Integration
[*] Sexual preferences of hosts in Liberation mode. You can control what kind of sex scenes you see by choosing hosts that align with your preferences.
[*] Some female sex partners in Compliance mode before Spreading starts
[*] Some new hairstyles can randomly trigger when maxing Hair length.
[*] A new formula for calculating upgrade cost that aims at avoiding infinite gain by upgrading one unit a lot
[*] Returned Unit Upgrade Mutation Values to original values (4%/8%)
[*] You can now use three Bacteriophages per area
[*] Higher Specializations now gain more bacteriophargs at the end of the run
[*] Increased Max Bacteriophages the Player can have to 20 per host
[*] The rarity of the mutation boon for auto-attacking medication enemies has been changed to Rare (was Shiny)
[*] A control unit for turning Stochastic Fluctuation per Area on/off
[*] Auto Click by hovering over the Medication enemies
[*] Main Story dialogs will now only trigger if there's no bonus active.
[*] Leveling up the Immune System will now give an immediate decrease to all active Immune reactions by 20 points
[*] fixed some controller issues with new mechanics
[*] fixed some typos
[/list]

Main new Features in smaller patches, that were added over the last few days:
[list]
[*] NSFW Mode for the Liberation story
[*] New Mutation Boon: Bacteriophage Unit that lets you auto-buy units
[*] New Mutation Boon: Stochastic fluctuation that lets you automatically level up areas (except clothes choices)
[*] Added end-of-run reward: +1 Bacteriophage on new runs
[*] New Setting for auto-advancing dialogs
[*] Nerfed Medication Enemies
[/list]


I hope these features will improve your experience. I'm very willing to enhance the gameplay, and I'd happily hear your concerns on Discord or the Discussions board to see if I can fix them.

Best,
Rel

notes.title: V1.0.6 expands Idle Gameplay
notes.content:
Hey everyone,
Today's update addresses some criticism of the Idle gameplay and introduces some bug fixes. There will be a few more smaller updates until this weekend, so stay tuned.

Here are today's changes.

 Features:
[list]
[*] New Mutation Boon: Bacteriopharg Unit that lets you auto-buy units
[*] New Mutation Boon: Stochastic fluctuation that lets you automatically level up areas (except clothes choices)
[*] Added end-of-run reward: +1 Bacteriopharg on new runs
[*] New Setting for auto-advancing dialogs
[/list]

Balancing:
[list]
[*] Changed Max-Body-Score in Compliance mode depending on Specialization. None is 7. All others are 10. Some are higher.
[*] Removed the mechanic that scales up Es-Sigma costs of higher specializations.
[*] Rebalanced some Mutation Boon effects
[/list]

Bugs:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that let players mutate a second time from a host that had already been used to Mutate
[*] Fixed a bug that didn't remove the mutation boon chosen on a host that loses connection
[*] Fixed a bug that led to the menu button not being shown on the end screen.
[*] Fixed a bug that led to upgrade sorting being wrong if nothing had been selected. Reverted to previous default.
[/list]

Misc:
[list]
[*] added a Confirmation screen before playing Compliance story for non-kinky players
[*] added more explanation to the Libido requirements for advancing gameplay in Compliance story
[/list]

I hope you enjoy these changes and look forward to playing more Femdemic over the next few days.

Best,
Rel

notes.title: V1.0.5 reduces Medication Spawns
notes.content:
​Hey everyone,

I have a few more patches planned over the coming days, with mostly Balancing and Quality of Life changes that players have proposed. The first one today is V1.05, which adds two things:

Medication Spawns
- reduced the maximum number of spawns per area to 1
- increased the effect on production (to account for the reduced number of spawns)
- prolonged the time between spawns
- reduced the chance for spawns while the game is not running

Settings
- a new setting to choose the order in which production units are displayed
- a new setting to choose the order in which upgrades are displayed

Keep your eyes out for more updates over the coming days, and thank you for playing.

Best,
Rel
